en: A monochrome historical postcard showing a large military barracks complex with several long three‑story buildings arranged around interior courtyards, bordered by a road and a fenced wall in the foreground. The scene is set in a largely rural landscape with fields and low hills in the distance. German text is printed at the top identifying the place as the barracks of the 2nd Royal Saxon Jäger Battalion No. 13 in Meissen.
